title: Zesty Crisp Syrian Chicken Kebabs
description: A lazy Sunday Syrian dish featuring crispy chicken kebabs with a zesty flavor, served with a side of jammy sauce and a hint of milk chocolate, made with bhuna spices and shojin-friendly ingredients. This dish is perfect for a relaxing afternoon meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the bhuna spice blend, salt, and garlic.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the skewers for 20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and crispy.
While the chicken is baking, melt the milk chocolate chips in a small saucepan over low heat.
Stir the jam into the melted chocolate and remove from heat.
Serve the chicken kebabs with the zesty chocolate sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with lemon wedges and serve immediately.
